scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist --local --port 8788
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply public-submission --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply public-submission --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name accountabilityledger
